decisions.text: Authorize forensic verification of the full AGRIS catalog target of 1,244 dcat:downloadURL entries across GitHub, local Git, runtime storage, archives, caches, and Docker mounts.
Forbid re-download of the 1,244 catalog packages within this mission; reuse existing packages only; document Missing after exhaustive search.
Process 100% of existing verified eligible packages into LocalIndex search path under license constraints.
Processing Completeness and Catalog Coverage Completeness are independent acceptance dimensions.
Authorize ordinary engineering design/implementation/test decisions and Commit/Push of tested task-owned changes within stated boundaries.

boundaries: No destructive Git or LocalIndex generation deletion
